name: ffvi-reweb
description: Evidence-driven FFVI web migration and HD-2D reconstruction pipeline

scripts.pipeline: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js compile
scripts.corpus:plan: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js corpus
scripts.npc:check: npm run build && node scripts/check-interactions.mjs npc
scripts.objects:check: npm run build && node scripts/check-interactions.mjs objects && node scripts/check-object-flow.mjs
scripts.game:build: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js field
scripts.battle:build: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js battle
scripts.playable:check: npm run game:build && npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-playable.mjs
scripts.inventory-events:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-inventory-events-native.mjs && node scripts/check-inventory-ownership-native.mjs && node scripts/check-inventory-events.mjs
scripts.party:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-party-native.mjs && node scripts/check-party.mjs && node scripts/check-party-menu.mjs
scripts.vitality:check: npm run build && node scripts/check-vitality-native.mjs && node scripts/check-parameters.mjs
scripts.battle-received-ability:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-battle-received-ability.mjs --native build/runtime/game/GameAssembly.dll
scripts.roster-lifecycle:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-roster-lifecycle-native.mjs && node scripts/check-roster-lifecycle.mjs
scripts.battle-timing:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-battle-timing.mjs --native build/runtime/game/GameAssembly.dll
scripts.field-conditions:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-field-conditions-native.mjs && node scripts/check-field-conditions.mjs
scripts.owned-character:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-owned-character-native.mjs && node scripts/check-owned-character.mjs
scripts.character-growth:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-character-growth-native.mjs && node scripts/check-character-growth.mjs
scripts.party-actors:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-party-actors-native.mjs && node scripts/check-party-actors.mjs
scripts.transportation:check: npm run build && node scripts/check-transportation-native.mjs && node scripts/check-transportation.mjs
scripts.systems:check: npm run game:build && npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-system-integration.mjs
scripts.battle-abilities:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-battle-abilities-native.mjs && node scripts/check-battle-abilities.mjs && node scripts/check-battle-abilities-ui.mjs
scripts.map-party-entry:check: npm run world:build && node scripts/check-map-party-entry-native.mjs && node scripts/check-map-party-entry.mjs
scripts.treasure-inventory:check: npm run battle:build && node scripts/check-treasure-inventory-native.mjs && node scripts/check-treasure-inventory.mjs
